name: Arc Spend

status_evidence.title: Arc Spend: spend USDC on Arc on real gift cards

summary: Independent web app that sells Bitrefill gift cards for USDC on Arc. Its live config points at Arc mainnet (chain ID 5042, rpc.mainnet.arc.io) with payments switched on. Not listed on arc.io/ecosystem; no Circle or Arc announcement found.

name: WalletConnect Pay

status_evidence.title: The WalletConnect Network supports Arc, connecting apps from day one

summary: WalletConnect's crypto payment product for merchants and PSPs. WalletConnect's Arc launch post (2026-09-16) says consumers can pay with WalletConnect Pay on Arc in USDC. Its docs' chain list (General Availability) does not list Arc yet.

name: Glidepay

status_evidence.title: Launch note: glidepay is live on Arc mainnet

summary: Cash App-style stablecoin app on Arc with email or Google sign-in and Circle developer-controlled smart accounts (Circle holds the keys). Its launch note says it went live on Arc mainnet on 2026-09-24. Universal Receive is not live yet.
